powershell: "py_procs=" + ((Get-Process python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Id.ToString() + ":" + [int]$_.CPU }) -join ","); $t = Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP -Filter "pip-*" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if($t){ "pip_tmp=" + $t.Name + " mb=" + [math]::Round((Get-ChildItem $t.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum/1MB,1) + " age_min=" + [int]((Get-Date) - $t.LastWriteTime).TotalMinutes }; "free_e_gb=" + [math]::Round((Get-PSDrive E).Free/1GB,1)
